title: RollerOvenTestData Schema
description: The roller oven test evaluates the compatibility between a drilling fluid and a shale sample. The shale sample is exposed to the drilling fluid by creating a colloidal suspension, under elevated thermal and mechanical stress in a roller oven. The effectiveness of the inhibition fluid is assessed through the amount of sample which is recovered or disaggregated.

items.title: Frame of Reference Meta Data Item
items.description: A meta data item, which allows the association of named properties or property values to a Unit/Measurement/CRS/Azimuth/Time context.

kind.title: UOM Reference Kind
kind.description: The kind of reference, 'Unit' for FrameOfReferenceUOM.

name.title: UOM Unit Symbol
name.description: The unit symbol or name of the unit.

persistableReference.title: UOM Persistable Reference
persistableReference.description: The self-contained, persistable reference string uniquely identifying the Unit.

unitOfMeasureID.description: SRN to unit of measure reference.

propertyNames.title: UOM Property Names
propertyNames.description: The list of property names, to which this meta data item provides Unit context to. A full path like "StructureA.PropertyB" is required to define a unique context; "data" is omitted since frame-of reference normalization only applies to the data block.

persistableReference.title: DateTime Persistable Reference
persistableReference.description: The self-contained, persistable reference string uniquely identifying DateTime reference.

TotalClay.title: Total Clay
TotalClay.description: Total clay mineral concentration in the sample.

WellFluidsReportID.title: Well Fluids Report ID
WellFluidsReportID.description: The OSDU Identifier for the Well Fluids Report associated with this analysis.

TestFluidVolume.title: Test Fluid Volume
TestFluidVolume.description: Volume of test fluid that is used to create a colloidal suspension.

RollingTemperature.title: Rolling Temperature
RollingTemperature.description: Temperature of the rolling oven at which the test was conducted.

SieveMeshSize.title: Sieve Mesh Size
SieveMeshSize.description: Mesh size of the sieve used in sample recovery.

MeshSizeTypeID.title: Mesh Size Type ID
MeshSizeTypeID.description: Mesh size type, e.g. Tyler or US.

InitialSampleWeight.title: Initial Sample Weight
InitialSampleWeight.description: Initial weight of sample before the test.

FinalSampleWeight.title: Final Sample Weight
FinalSampleWeight.description: Final weight of recovered sample after the test.

SampleContainerWeight.title: Sample Container Weight
SampleContainerWeight.description: The weight of the tare or sample container.

FinalTotalWeight.title: Final Total Weight
FinalTotalWeight.description: The final weight of the recovered sample and tare.

RecoveryPercent.title: Recovery Percent
RecoveryPercent.description: The fraction of recovered sample weight after rolling and sieving, over the initial sample weight.

DisaggregationPercent.title: Disaggregation Percent
DisaggregationPercent.description: The fraction of disaggregated sample weight, after rolling and sieving, over the initial sample weight.

Remarks.title: Remarks
Remarks.description: Array object capturing remarks or additional information for this test step.  Remarks for the analysis as a whole should be captured in the associated SamplesAnalysis work product component.

RemarkSequenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for each remark record. This identifier is used to uniquely identify a member in an array of remarks.
